entry.summary: 23 March 2026  Government ministers were out in force in Kawerau as Conservation Minister Tama Potaka cut the ribbon on Cool-Safe’s new refrigerant destruction facility while Minister of Trade and Investment Todd McClay inaugurated Eastland Generation’s TOPP2 geothermal power plant.  “Eastland Generation and Cool-Safe are helping cement Kawerau’s position as a centre for sustainable energy and kaitiaki taiao | environmental stewardship,” said the Mayor of Kawerau Her Worship Faylene Tunui.
